README.md

_front-html___

Public hub of the owner's HTML front ends.

  • diegonmarcos.github.io/ : git submodule, the GitHub Pages site repo.
  • profile/ : git submodule, diegonmarcos/diegonmarcos (the GitHub profile README).
  • Every other owner-declared html repo is a submodule too (list: html-repos.json; .gitmodules is generated from it by node scripts/gen-gitmodules.mjs, guard --check in CI).
  • pages.json : every public repo of the owner that publishes GitHub Pages (repo, url, source, public). Generated by scripts/gen-pages.mjs from the GitHub API, never edited by hand. Only public Pages URLs are listed.
  • .github/workflows/pages-drift.yml : daily (and on push) regenerates pages.json and fails when it differs from the committed file.

Use

git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/diegonmarcos/_front-html___ GH_TOKEN=... node scripts/gen-pages.mjs # rewrite pages.json GH_TOKEN=... node scripts/gen-pages.mjs --check # exit 1 on drift

Consumers

Cloud Browser (Favourites > GH Pages) reads https://raw.githubusercontent.com/diegonmarcos/_front-html___/main/pages.json at runtime and keeps the last good copy as a cache.

Consolidated repo pages (repos-pages.json)

One generated entry per html repo: name, folder (submodule path), github, pages_url (own GitHub Pages, from pages.json), custom_domain + cnames (CNAME files), overlay_pages (folders of diegonmarcos.github.io built from the repo, per the site's ship.yml PROJECTS) and domain_pages (every *.diegonmarcos.com host the fleet Caddyfile routes to those folders; the Pages site lists all). Most html repos publish no Pages of their own (so they are absent from pages.json, e.g. cloud-me-pub-profiles-prf-prs): they are served through diegonmarcos.github.io/<folder>/ and the domain pages. sot_html marks the SoT kind html (git-repos-master kinds.json); other entries are declared in html-repos.json only (renamed or private).

node scripts/gen-repos-pages.mjs --scan # refresh repos-pages.scan.json from GitHub (gh), then write node scripts/gen-repos-pages.mjs # offline: cache + SoTs -> repos-pages.json node scripts/gen-repos-pages.mjs --check # drift guard (CI: pages-drift.yml, job repos-pages) node tests/test-repos-pages.mjs # every SoT html repo on every surface, mutation-proven

Surfaces checked: .gitmodules, html-repos.json, gitlink, index.json, index.html, repos-tree.json, 00_repos-tree/dist, repos-pages.json.

Repos tree (00_repos-tree/)

The hub's own tree of html repos. Same layout as _git-repos-master/A0_repos-tree: 00_repos-tree/src/ (input: filter.json; the html.tmpl and md.tmpl are the submodule's), 00_repos-tree/dist/ (outputs: json, md, html with Item List / Table / Canvas views and an All / HTML / LFS / Others filter, xml, canvas) and the same outputs at the repo root (repos-tree.*). There is no list in this repo: git-repos-master/ is a git submodule and the tree is its A0_repos-tree/dist/repos-tree.json filtered to kind html.

git submodule update --init --remote git-repos-master # bump the data node scripts/gen-repos-tree.mjs # src -> dist -> root node scripts/gen-repos-tree.mjs --check # drift guard (CI: repos-tree.yml) node tests/test-repos-tree.mjs

Index (index.json, index.html)

index.html is an icon grid of every HTML entry point of every public sub-repo, grouped by project family, with search, group filter, light/dark and a mobile layout. Links are relative and assume the parent git/ folder is the served root (../<repo>/<path>). Private repos (no_deploy in html-repos.json, e.g. project-pvt-all) are never fetched or listed.

  • index.json: hand-kept hub (the hub's own folder/repo name: the only place to change on a repo rename), groups, repos (title, icon, description, group, dir), overrides (per <repo>/<path>), exclude/include regexes; generated pins + entries.
  • node scripts/gen-index.mjs --scan refreshes entries from the pinned gitlinks via blobless depth-1 git fetches (trees only, a few MB, no submodule checkout, follows repo renames); node scripts/gen-index.mjs renders index.html; --check fails on drift. Entry point = root *.html or index.html outside src/static/test/node_modules, dist/ preferred, sub-pages under another app's entry collapsed.
  • Node, not sh: the repo's generators are already Node, JSON and HTML escaping are native, and the same module is imported by the tests (no jq/sed escaping pitfalls, deterministic sorted output).
  • node tests/test-index.mjs: schema, entry rule, deterministic render == committed file, private exclusion, then a temp served tree (only the linked files, read at the pinned SHA) behind a throwaway local server, checked headless with Playwright: every card link 200, search, click-through. CI: .github/workflows/index.yml (on push and submodule bump: rescan, commit, test).
